subject: Night crew rotation + vertical banner exception for Bay 9
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hana Park <hana@venueco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night crew rotation + vertical banner exception for Bay 9

Hana / Venue team —

Quick heads-up on two items for Redwood booth (Bay 9) that need confirmation before we lock crate shipments:

1) Vertical banner exception
- We plan to install a 12.0 ft vertical fabric banner behind the demo counter. The artwork & specs attached (banner-spec-vertical.pdf). Bay 9 standard standoffs are 8 ft, so this will require a waiver/exception from fire marshals or an alternate secure mount. Can you confirm whether the venue can sign off on an exception or if we must reduce height to <=8 ft?

2) Night crew crate rotation
- We will do a crate swap (two crates) during the night load window on Monday night, April 29. We need access to the loading dock and a security escort from 11:00 PM–12:30 AM. Freight will be from FreightOps (ops@crateship.com). Please confirm availability of a night escort and that Bay 9 loader window remains open until 12:30 AM.

Attachments: banner-spec-vertical.pdf, bay9-floorplan-v3.png

As always, appreciate a quick reply so we can confirm final print quantity and mounting hardware.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

---
Note: Marissa / Sean / Marcus — looping you in for logistics and mounting plan suggestions.
From: Hana Park <hana@venueco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2029 13:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night crew rotation + vertical banner exception for Bay 9

Monica —

Thanks for the detailed note and files. Quick answers:

1) Vertical banner exception: possible but requires a formal exception request and a mounting diagram from your installer. We need to review the mounting method, weight, and any proximity to egress paths. Please provide a mounting-diagram and indicate whether the banner is fabric or rigid. If fabric and tensioned, we may be able to allow 12 ft with a certified mount anchored to the booth frame.

2) Night crew escort: I confirmed with operations — we can provide a security escort for 11:00 PM–12:30 AM on Monday (April 29). Please submit the crew list and vehicle plate numbers 48 hours prior. Loader window will remain open to 12:30 AM but will be locked immediately after the escort leaves; late arrivals will be denied.

I am copying Luis Moreno (venue ops) so he can coordinate lock/unlock and the exception process.

Best,
Hana Park
Event Services Manager
Bay9 Convention Center
hana@venueco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night crew rotation + vertical banner exception for Bay 9

Team —

Thanks Monica / Hana. Attached is the mounting-diagram.jpg and a short mounting spec from our vendor (we're using rigging-rated clamps and a tensioned fabric sleeve). Key notes from vendor & onsite installer:
- Banner is fabric (non-rigid), printed on flame-retardant textile, hemmed with D-rings. Approx weight: 18 lbs total.
- Proposed mount is two top clamp points to the booth truss and a bottom tension line to prevent swaying.
- We will not obstruct the aisle or the emergency egress path; see bay9-floorplan-v3.png for placement (banner sits 1.5 ft behind the demo counter, not in the cross-aisle).

Crate rotation operational plan (draft):
- 22:30 arrival: FreightOps drops off empty crates at staging A (dock 4).
- 23:00–23:45: Night crew (2 installers + 1 site manager) unload and rotate crates into booth.
- 23:45–00:00: Site manager signs off with security; crates staged inside Bay 9 behind barricade.
- Security escort requested 23:00–00:15 to allow for minor delays.

Action items for this thread:
- Monica: submit installer name & vehicle plates to Hana 48 hrs prior (per venue).
- Sean: order hardware kit (2x rigging clamps, 1x tension line, spare carabiners).
- Marcus: confirm crate labels & manifest with FreightOps.

Attachments: mounting-diagram.jpg, crate-rotation-stub.pdf

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
